purpose: Jovi Stage-AA v3 audition feedback. One entry per key scene. Scores are 0-100 integers. Blind identity is NOT included; binding happens after feedback receipt.

scene_fields.vehicle_identity_0_100: does it sound like a supercharged 6.2L V8 Hellcat
scene_fields.realism_0_100: overall realism vs a real recording
scene_fields.blower_identity_0_100: supercharger presence: real whine vs electronic whistle
scene_fields.overall_preference: one of: AA-C3 | Stage-Z | Parent | tie | cannot_decide

free_form_notes: allowed; raw feedback is stored verbatim and hashed before any reveal

binding_protocol.on_receipt: save raw feedback file, compute feedback_sha256, then reveal B/C identity, then write human_feedback_binding.json

audition_domains.timbre_review: shared RMS matching allowed; judge body, mechanical texture, blower timbre, spectral balance, synthetic character
audition_domains.dynamic_review: NO per-clip loudness normalization; judge idle->WOT, tip-in, shift, lift, idle return, afterfire relative impact
